 Morgan Wallen: Last Time I Checked Tour 2027
 August 13, 2027 
 Register for Artist Presale 
 Morgan Wallen announces his return to the road in 2027 with his Last Time I Checked Tour with special guests Brooks & Dunn, HARDY, Cole Swindell and Stella Lefty .
 Wallen has earned 23 No.1 singles at country radio, making him the fastest artist in history to reach the milestone. With 19 Billboard Music Awards to-date, more than 237 weeks spent atop Billboard’s Top Country Albums chart (the most in country music history), and the highest selling country tour under his belt, Wallen continues to set records across music and touring. Wallen’s fourth studio album, I’m The Problem (2025), debuted at No.1 globally across seven countries and has spent 14 non-consecutive weeks atop theBillboard 200 albums chart, further cementing his global influence.
 As with previous tours, a portion of every ticket sold will benefit his Morgan Wallen Foundation (MWF) —which supports programs for youth in the areas of sports and music. For more information, visit MorganWallenFoundation.org. 
 Presale registration is now open through Thursday, November 19 at 9pm CT at LastTimeICheckedTour.com . 
 Public on-sale begins on Friday, November 20 at 10am CT at SeatGeek.com.
 Note: Tickets are required for kids ages 2 and up.
